rules.title: RichFaces / ICEfaces / a4j (end of life)
rules.message: Component library discontinued; blocks JSF/Jakarta upgrades.

rules.title: Struts 1 (end of life since 2013)
rules.message: Unsupported framework with known unpatched vulnerabilities.

rules.title: Struts 2
rules.message: Framework with a history of critical RCE CVEs: verify version.

rules.title: DWR (Direct Web Remoting, end of life)
EJB 2.x component model
rules.message: EJB 2.x / CMP entity beans are removed from Jakarta EE.

rules.title: Apache Axis 1 (end of life)
rules.message: Unmaintained since 2006 with known vulnerabilities.

rules.title: JAXB (javax.xml.bind, removed from JDK 11)
rules.message: Needs explicit dependency on Java 11+ and jakarta.xml.bind on Jakarta EE 9+.

rules.title: Local filesystem access
rules.message: Stateful local storage: affects horizontal scaling and containerization.

rules.title: JBoss / WildFly proprietary API
rules.message: Couples the application to the JBoss/WildFly runtime.

rules.title: javax.* Java EE namespace (pre Jakarta EE 9)
rules.message: Requires the javax→jakarta namespace migration for Jakarta EE 9+ runtimes.

rules.title: Internal JDK APIs (sun.*)
rules.message: Strongly encapsulated since Java 16; some removed.

rules.title: Unmanaged threads
rules.message: Unmanaged threads inside a container bypass its lifecycle and context.

rules.title: Log4j 1.x (end of life, CVEs)
rules.message: End of life since 2015 with unpatched vulnerabilities (e.g. CVE-2019-17571).

rules.title: Log4j 2
rules.message: Verify version >= 2.17.1 (Log4Shell family).

rules.title: JSP scriptlets
rules.message: Business logic embedded in views.

rules.title: Java native deserialization
rules.message: Review for untrusted input (deserialization attacks).

rules.title: Possible hard-coded credential in configuration
rules.message: Value is never copied to the report; check location and rotate if real.

rules.title: Possible hard-coded credential in XML
rules.message: Value is never copied to the report.

rules.title: Possible hard-coded credential in code
rules.message: Value is never copied to the report.

rules.title: Credentials embedded in a connection string or URL
rules.message: User and password inside the connection string; the value is never copied to the report. Move it to a secret store and rotate it.

rules.title: Keystore / private key file committed
rules.message: A key container in the repository may hold private keys: check its content (truststores with only public certificates are reported as info).

rules.title: Hard-coded IP address
rules.message: Environment-specific address in the repository.

rules.title: Oracle-specific SQL
rules.message: Proprietary SQL hinders database portability.

rules.title: Stored procedures / packages
rules.message: Business logic in the database.

match: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE p AS BEGIN NULL; END;

rules.title: Database links
rules.message: Hidden database-to-database integration.

rules.title: Database-initiated network/file access
rules.message: The database itself integrates with external systems.

rules.title: Database jobs
rules.message: Batch processes scheduled inside the database.

match: EXEC SQL SELECT A INTO :B FROM T END-EXEC.

rules.title: WCF services
rules.message: WCF server is not available on modern .NET (CoreWCF required).

rules.title: ASP.NET Web Forms
rules.message: Not supported on .NET Core / .NET 5+.

rules.title: AngularJS 1.x (end of life)
rules.message: End of life since January 2022.

rules.title: Legacy JS libraries (Dojo, ExtJS, Prototype, YUI, Backbone)
X.509 / client-certificate authentication (mTLS)
rules.message: Client-certificate authentication implies mutual TLS (mTLS).

rules.title: WS-Security (SOAP message security)
rules.message: Message-level security on SOAP services; check tokens, signature and encryption.

rules.title: HTTP Basic credentials in an outbound client
Bearer token in an outbound client
Client certificate received in an HTTP header (mTLS terminated by an intermediary)
rules.message: The application reads the client certificate from a header: an intermediary (proxy, API gateway, load balancer) terminates mutual TLS in front of it. Who requires it and which consumers use it is not in the code.

rules.title: Client certificate data received in an HTTP header (mTLS terminated by an intermediary)
rules.message: Subject, serial number or verification result of a client certificate arrive in a header: likely mutual TLS terminated by an intermediary.

rules.title: Configured header carrying the client certificate
rules.message: A header that carries the client certificate is configured: mutual TLS is likely terminated by an intermediary.

rules.title: Client TLS identity (keystore) — mutual TLS
rules.message: A client keystore configures mutual TLS (client-certificate) on outbound calls.

rules.title: TLS verification disabled
rules.message: Certificate or hostname verification is bypassed: traffic is not authenticated.

rules.title: Custom login: own authentication provider or filter
rules.message: User login implemented by the application itself (the class named in the evidence).

rules.title: Pre-authenticated SSO (login done by a gateway or the container)
rules.message: The application trusts an identity established upstream (reverse proxy, SSO gateway or container).

rules.title: Container-managed authentication
rules.message: Login is configured in the application server (security domain / realm), outside the application code.

rules.title: Liberty TLS with client certificates (mTLS)
rules.message: Open Liberty / WebSphere Liberty requires (or accepts) client certificates.

match: PdfSigner signer = new PdfSigner(reader, out, props);

rules.title: Advanced electronic signature (XAdES / CAdES / PAdES / JAdES)
Libraries committed to the repository
rules.message: Dependencies without a manager: versions and CVEs are hard to track.

rules.title: Artifact repository over plain HTTP
rules.message: Dependencies downloaded without TLS can be tampered with.
